<head-word>בִּנְיָן, </head-word>

<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> בָּנָה)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>building, structure; erection</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Succ. 51
<sup>b</sup> מי שלא ראה בה"מ בבִנְיָנוֹ whoever has not seen the Temple in its finished state, expl. ibid. בִּנְיַן הורדוס the Herodian Temple (Ms. M. … ראה בנין בה"מ; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note).—אַמַּת הב', v. אַמָּה.—Sabb. 102
<sup>b</sup> דרך ב' בכן such kind of labor belongs to builders’ work. Ib. דמי לב' it looks like builders’ work; a. fr.—בִּנְיַן אב 
<italic>standard rule</italic>, v. אָב; v. Ḥull. 78
<sup>b</sup>, B. Kam. 77
<sup>b</sup> זה בנה אב this (Ex. XII, 5) forms the rule, wherever שה is used &c. (v. Tosaf. a. l.).—Sabb. 114
<sup>a</sup> בִּנְיָנוֹ של עולם the preservation of the (mental and moral) world.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>human frame, skeleton.</italic></definition>
<notes> Ohol. II, 1 רוב בניינו the greater portion of a corpse as to size of limbs, contrad. to רוב מניינו the larger as to the number of joints and limbs.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="B01037">

<sup>b</sup> ובעו לה מבעיא האי וכ' and put it as a question (not as an argument), Does this 
<italic>uba hash-shemesh</italic> mean &c.? (opposed to preceding וממאי דהאי וכ' how can it be proven that &c.). Y. Ḥall. I, 57
<sup>b</sup> רבנן … בעיין the Rabbis of … asked. B. Kam. 33
<sup>a</sup> בעא … מרב וכ' R. asked R. N.; a. v. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to ask, pray</italic>, frequ.</definition>
<notes> ב' רחמין 
<italic>to ask for mercy, pray</italic>. Targ. Y. Num. XII, 13; a. fr.—Ber. 8
<sup>a</sup> לבעי אינש רחמי man should pray &c., v. זיבולא. Ib. 10
<sup>a</sup> בְּעִי רחמי עלויהו וכ' pray thou for them that they may repent; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to ask, want, desire; to require</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Ex. II, 15; a. fr.—Pes. 9
<sup>a</sup> ובָעֵי בדיקה and it (the house) requires searching over again. Keth. 39
<sup>b</sup> לא בעינא לך I do not want thee. B. Kam. 102
<sup>b</sup> לא יקרייכו בעינא וכ' I want neither your honor nor your disrespect; a. fr.—Pes. 2
<sup>a</sup> בעו שבוחי 
<italic>must</italic> give praise.—אי בעית אימא, usu. איבעית אימא, v. אִיבָּעִית. [Y. Yeb. XII, 13
<sup>a</sup> top בְּעֵא תתן לנו, please, give us.]</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—4)</number>
<definition> (ellipt.) 
<italic>to beg leave to say; to remark, assert</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ber. I, 2
<sup>b</sup> top. Y. Peah II, beg. 16
<sup>d</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Ithpe.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>אִתְבְּעִי</binyan-form>

<number>1)</number>

<sup>b</sup>, a. v. fr. אִיבָּעְיָא להו it was asked by them (the scholars), i.e. the argument came up.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be required; it ought to</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. 7
<sup>b</sup> יצא בו מיבעי ליה it ought to read 
<italic>yatsa bo</italic> (he 
<italic>has</italic> done his duty). Ib. 15
<sup>a</sup> מדבריו מ' ליה it ought to be 
<italic>midd’barav</italic> (not 
<italic>middibrehem</italic>); a. fr.—B. Kam. 21
<sup>b</sup> א' ליה לאסוקי דעתא he ought to have borne in mind; a. fr.—לא מיבעיא

<entry id="B01128">

<senses>
<sense>
<definition> , v. 
<xref rid="B01111">בְּקָא</xref>) </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, chop; to break through</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 99
<sup>a</sup> בָּ' בו; (Kidd. 47
<sup>b</sup> בִּיקַּע) if he chopped wood with it. Gen. R. s. 55, end; Koh. R. to X, 9; II, 23, v. בְּקִיעָה. Ex. R. s. 21 אני בוֹקֵעַ להם וכ' I am going to split the sea for them; a. fr.—Lam. R. to II, 2 בקעו בחיילותיו וכ' broke through the lines of N.’s armies; Y. Taan. IV, 69
<sup>b</sup> top ברחו לתוך.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cross, make a short cut, pass over</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Pes. I, 27
<sup>b</sup> bot. חצר שהרבים בּוֹקְעִין וכ' a court which people use for crossing. Erub. 16
<sup>b</sup>; Sabb. 101
<sup>b</sup> (a low wall) שהגדיים וכ' ב' over which the kids pass; v. בִּקְעָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—3)</number>
<definition> (cmp. בִּצְבֵּץ) 
<italic>to break through the ground</italic>, esp. as a legal fiction for a levitical impurity the cause of which is underground, but which affects the things above and beneath.</definition>
<notes> Ohol. VI, 6 טומאה בּוֹקַעַת וכ' the impurity breaks through the ground and rises, and breaks through and goes down; a. fr.—Koh. R. III, 16 היה הדם בו' ועולה the blood broke through and rose. Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45 ב' את הצור, ב' בצור break through (take root in) the rock; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִבְקַע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be split, to burst open</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib. הסיפין נבקעין וכ' the door sells were burst before them. Ib. נ' הספל מאליו the vessel went to pieces of itself. Gen. R. s. 55, end זכה להִבָּקַע הים וכ' he was rewarded by the sea being divided before the children of Israel. Ḥull. 14
<sup>b</sup> שמא יִבָּקַע הנוד the wine bottle may burst; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>בִּקַּע, בִּיקַּע</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to split, chop, tear</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Kidd. 47
<sup>b</sup>, v. supra. Y. Bets. I, 60
<sup>a</sup> bot.; Y. Ab. Zar. II, 41
<sup>c</sup> bot. שביקעו (שבקעו) להם וכ' of whose flocks the wolves had torn more than &c. Bets. IV, 3 אין מְבַקְּעִין וכ' one must not split woods (on Holy Days) etc. Sifré Deut. 183 (ref. to Deut. XIX, 5) מן העץ המְבַקֵּעַ from the 
<italic>splitting</italic> wood (the handle), opp. העץ המִתְבַּקֵּעַ the 
<italic>split</italic> wood (the tree). Tanḥ. Vayetse 9 בַּקְּעִי וכ' chop thou &c.—Part. pass. מְבוּקָּע. Ab. Zar. 65
<sup>b</sup> מְבוּקָּעוֹת grapes burst open.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to jam in, wedge</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sabb. 67
<sup>b</sup> המְבַקַּעַת ביצים (Rashi Var. המקבעת, Ms. M. עצים) one who squeezes egg-shells &c. (a superstitious practice; Tosef. ib. VI (VII), 18 הנותנת בצים … בכותל).</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִבְקִיעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to cut, clear.</italic></definition>
<notes> Shebi. IV, 5 המַבְקִיעַ בזתים וכ' he who cuts olive-trees down (in the Sabbath year) must not cover the stump with ground.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lead a line crosswise</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Kil. III, 28
<sup>d</sup> top להַבְקִיעַ וכ' to plant four rows across a valley from end to end.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִתְבַּקֵּעַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be split; to burst, break</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Sifré Deut. 183, v. supra.—Sabb. XVI, 5. Cant. R. to VI, 4.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>
